name: Plans
description: Sellable packages per product. Prices are KDV hariç, in TRY. Leave price_try empty until prices are set. Contracts, payment and subscriptions live in each product's own backend; the landing only links to checkout_url. Empty checkout_url → 'write to us to buy'. Only plans of live products are sold.

checkout_url.description: The product's own purchase page (its backend handles contracts, payment and subscription). Empty = 'write to us to buy' button.

note.description: e.g. 'Her yıl TÜFE/ÜFE ile güncellenir', taksit notu.

price_try.description: KDV hariç TL. Boş = fiyat henüz yayında değil.
